policy.interpretation: Prospective material angular repair and response-retention margins. These are engineering experiment criteria, not application accuracy tolerances or equivalence tests.
policy.statistic: Use the same hierarchical available_truth_rmse as headline comparisons; parentRMSEp95 uses the existing parent balancing and NumPylinearquantile. Apply the unchanged physical floors. Weak probes remain in raw response scores. Exact same queries and truth masks for both arms.

development_diagnosis.finding: Much angular loss exists at initialization; later training trades additional rate error for rotation gain. Public and bilinear later recorded checkpoints worsen all three 250ms groups against their own initialization.
development_diagnosis.limits: Development only; no intermediate held-out forecasts or hindsight selection. Initial feature/regularization/state-support causes remain unisolated.

execution.timing_limits: Concurrent unpaced CPU jobs; data/update budgets matched, not FLOPs. General tracing overhead is included in fit wall time.

integration: Integrate diagnostic evidence and replay harness; do not promote bilinear or alter public recipe.
next_mechanism: Change only the existing joint ridge penalty center to the already-computed affine initializer; keep product priors zero and bias unpenalized, with identical strength, data, loss and update budget.
next_named_gap: Preserve useful affine dynamics while initializing full quadratic capacity.
remaining_qualification: No arbitrary-system, physical derivative, uncertainty, update or controller readiness established. Crazyflow accuracy remains conditional on incomplete truth.

verification.analysis_scope: Independent selected-test scope/cell/horizon reductions from saved predictions and truth, and all development checkpoints; see analysis script and JSON for exact scope.
verification.independent_scope: Independent NumPy 250 ms endpoint errors for four predictors, three pairwise physical comparisons/tails, primary tail gates and four angular-repair point gates; complete metric rosters and all-horizon truth/finiteness; exact prior public-excited/quadratic revisions, byte-exact historical excitation imports, hash-selected caches, six base norms, state-input scale and exact loss weights. Every arm checkpoint manifest, including failure or unavailable preparation, is checked against its outcome and trusted public-excited cache; all captured saved checkpoint predictions are independently reduced into channel/group MSE, objective contributions and parent tails with objective atol1e-12/rtol1e-10. Combined logic, reported aggregate gate arithmetic and bootstrap hash equality are checked. No independent other-horizon test scores, full-horizon test aggregates, bootstrap draws, optimizer trajectories, checkpoint capture, model prediction or simulator execution; historical excitation assignment is inherited from externally anchored prior evidence.
